annotation.bound_parties_text: The bill binds manufacturers of autonomous technology/vehicles (insurance, certifications, emergency response lines, geofencing compliance, notice reporting) and the Department of Motor Vehicles (regulations, application approval), and regulates operators/drivers of autonomous vehicles.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A manufacturer shall comply with all of the following requirements:
annotation.dates_quote: (g) This section shall become operative on July 1, 2026.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Section 38750 of the Vehicle Code is amended to read: ... “Autonomous vehicle” means any vehicle equipped with autonomous technology
